reasoning: Base ratings: the Kings are -8.7 and the Magic -3.0 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Magic 1.3 better here, total 227.
Rest, travel and availability move it 0.9 towards the Kings.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
